subject: Invoice origination mapping & AP handshake — proposal for multi-entity billing
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice origination mapping & AP handshake — proposal for multi-entity billing

Hi J. / AP team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To make sure we get the first few invoices right, we want to confirm who at Redwood should be the invoice "creator" for Acme Cloud and how you'd like the docs delivered (portal push vs. email PDF). A few items we need your guidance on: 

- Which legal entity should appear on the invoice for payments (Acme has two remit-to entities per your note)?
- Preferred delivery method: portal push (e-invoice / webhook) or emailed PDF (with CC to ap@acme-corp.com)?
- PO handling: confirm whether you prefer PO on invoice header or line-level PO mapping.
- VAT/evidence: for EU-sourced services you mentioned reverse-charge — what VAT evidence file/format do you need with the first billing cycle?

Attached is a small CSV with how we typically map invoice creator -> remit-to. Can you confirm the remit-to mapping and delivery preference so we can draft the first test invoice?

Next steps (suggested):
1) You confirm remit-to entity and delivery preference by EOD Wed
2) We send 1x test invoice (PDF + portal) for your AP to validate
3) On sign-off, we flip production flow and schedule monthly delivery

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0134

Attachment: sample-invoice-mapping.csv (CSV, 3 rows)

From: J. Moss <jmoss@acme-corp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origination mapping & AP handshake — proposal for multi-entity billing

Kimberly,

Thanks for the recap. A couple of clarifications from AP side: 

- Remit-to: For North America invoices please issue from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US remit). For EMEA invoices that trigger reverse-charge we need invoices from Redwood Inference EU LTD so VAT fields match our AP system.
- Delivery: Portal push (e-invoice) is preferred for production. However we need an emailed PDF copy to ap@acme-corp.com for our vendor file during the first two cycles.
- PO: We prefer PO number on the invoice header (single PO per invoice). If line-level references are present we ignore them in our system.
- VAT evidence: For reverse-charge, please include the customer's VAT ID and the statement: "Reverse charge applies — customer liable for VAT" in the invoice notes. PDF is fine; if you can attach a separate VAT proof file (PDF) during onboarding that helps.

We can confirm the remit mapping by EOD Wednesday (internal approver is on PTO until then).

Regards,
J. Moss
Senior AP Manager
Acme Cloud
jmoss@acme-corp.com
Attachment: none

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: J. Moss <jmoss@acme-corp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Sep 2029 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice origination mapping & AP handshake — proposal for multi-entity billing

Thanks J. — that's clear and aligns with what I expected. I've attached a draft mapping workbook (invoice-mapping-draft.xlsx) that shows how we'll route invoices based on product region and tax rules. Key points: 

- Two issuer rows: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) and Redwood Inference EU Ltd (EMEA).
- Delivery options: production => portal webhook (UBL/Peppol later), fallback => email PDF to ap@acme-corp.com and cc: onboarding@procurely.io if AP asks us to enroll in Procurely.
- For the first billing cycle we will: 
  1) Send 1x test invoice via portal + PDF to ap@acme-corp.com
  2) Attach VAT evidence PDF (if reverse-charge applies) to that test email
  3) Confirm PO display on header only

Questions for Acme (so we can finalize mapping):
- Exact legal name string for Redwood EU you expect on invoice (we have a couple of variants on file)
- Confirm whether your AP wants invoice numbers prefixed by entity (ex: EU-2029-XXXXX)

If no objections I'll schedule the test invoice for Oct 3 and route it to the sandbox endpoint.

Connor O'Brien
Billing & Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
Attachment: invoice-mapping-draft.xlsx (Workbook, 2 tabs)

Appreciate the quick reply, J. — this gives us everything we need to move forward. Final notes / next steps: 

- Connor will generate the draft test invoice using Redwood Inference EU Ltd for EMEA items and Redwood Inference, Inc. for NA items.
- We'll push the test invoice via the portal sandbox and email a PDF copy + VAT evidence PDF to ap@acme-corp.com.
- Marissa, can you confirm the templating flag to add the required reverse-charge note exactly as J. requested? Once you confirm I'll schedule the Oct 3 test.

If we get sign-off on remit mapping by Wed we'll keep Oct 3 as the target. Otherwise I'll follow up with a short checklist for your approver to expedite.

Thanks all,
Kimberly
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
